Loops around the block

Source: R/data.R
loops.Rd

This dataset contains 3 drives around Hardin Hall, the building of the former Statistics Department at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln. All measurements are based on GPS recordings at 2 second intervals:

Usage

loops

Format

A tibble with 270 rows and 10 columns

loop

integer variable between 1 and 3

lat

numeric, geographic latitude in degrees with CRS WGS84

lon

numeric, geographic longitude in degrees with CRS WGS84

ele

numeric, elevation above sea-level (in m)

time

dttm, timestamp of the recorded observation

heading

numeric, continuity-corrected direction of the car (in degrees with north at 0 degrees and increasing clockwise) as measured by GPS. The continuity correction takes the initial heading and adds the cumulative sum of the changes in heading for the subsequent observations.

speed

numeric, speed of the vehicle (in miles per hour)

start_loop

dttm, the timestamp of the start of the current loop

loop_seconds

numeric, number of seconds since the start of the current loop

heading_raw

numeric, raw, NOT continuity-corrected direction of the car (in degrees with north at 0 degrees and increasing clockwise) as calculated from the GPS point to GPS point.
